comparison.objective: Use a tweezer puller to remove a selected blade fuse and place it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool pickup, narrow-access gripping, extraction against clips, and precise release.
comparison.success_condition: Middle fuse extracted by the puller and released in tray; neighboring fuses undisturbed; tool set down and stable.
comparison.reason: Selective tool-mediated extraction of one retained component differs from bulk media passage through apertures.
